name: Caitlyn
description: Voice set for Officer Caitlyn (skin 5): a sharp-eyed beat cop who is routinely underestimated, tough, quick-witted and fond of a doughnut. Patrols, radios, stakeouts, verdicts and the end of shift. Builds on caitlyn-original.json.

messages.message: {momentTitle} is {voteDiff} behind and the crowd's thin. Radio for backup.
Thirty or more adrift. That's a code red. Every unit, please.
{momentTitle} trails by {voteDiff}. Put the call out on every channel.
Around fifteen short. Not hopeless, just badly parked.
Down {voteDiff}. Bring a partner. Nobody walks this beat alone.
{voteDiff} behind. A few good votes and we're back on pace.
Down {voteDiff}. Small gap, short shift. Close it before dispatch calls.
Dead level. One vote, one badge on the line. Make it yours.
A single vote apart. Quit loitering and cast it.
{voteDiff} votes between them. The whole precinct is holding its breath. Bring more.
{voteDiff} votes in it. A tense stakeout. Don't blink.
{momentTitle} sits at {userPct}%. Quiet streets so far. Keep your eyes open.
{userPct}% and rising. Don't clock off early.
{userPct}%. A decent night's work. Stay on shift.
{userPct}% behind your pick. We're walking this beat. Keep walking.
Up at {userPct}%. Lovely. Now see it through to the end of shift.
{momentTitle} was {voteDiff} down and just took the lead. Dispatch, we have a turnaround.
Down by {voteDiff}, now in front. Nicely handled, officer.
Out of a {voteDiff} hole and into the lead. Somebody's earned a doughnut.
{momentTitle} was sinking. Now it's leading the patrol.
{momentTitle} has surged into the lead. Nobody saw that coming. Except you, I'd wager.

messages: {username} voted with you on {momentTitle}. A partner on the beat, at last.
{username} backed {momentTitle} too. Sharp eyes on that one.
{username} sees it your way. Good, I was running short of squad.
Same pick as {username}. Two officers, one hunch.
{username} stood with {momentTitle}. Reliable instincts.
{username} made the same call. Saved me a radio message.
{username} is on your side of {momentTitle}. Pull up a chair.
{username} voted {momentTitle}. Welcome to the squad room.
{username} agrees on {momentTitle}. That's two witnesses, which is two more than usual.
details: Matching hunches. Always a good sign.
A reliable partner is a rare thing.

messages: {username} backed {theirMoment} over {yourMoment}. Different hunch. Let's see whose pans out.
{username} chose {theirMoment}. Wrong suspect, if you ask me.
{username} went against {yourMoment}. Unwise, but they're allowed to be.
{username} voted against you. A good rival keeps a cop sharp.
{username} took {theirMoment}. Brave. Possibly mistaken.
{username} opposes {yourMoment}. Fine. The final count will settle it.
{username} disagrees on {yourMoment}. Shall we compare notes at the finish?
{username} voted the other way. They'll come round once the evidence is in.
details: The tally will rule on it.
Rivals make you better at the job.
They may still change their statement.

messages: Ten in a row with {username}. That's not luck, that's good police work.
{username} and you, ten matches, the same verdict every time. Perfect partners.
Ten straight with {username}. I'd ride shotgun with you both.
A ten-match run with {username}. Not one disagreement on the books.
Ten for ten with {username}. That's a clean record.
details: Rare on this beat. Cherish it.

messages: {streakCount} matches with {username}. You're not partners anymore, you're a department.
{streakCount} in a row with {username}. I'd follow you both into any alley.
{streakCount} straight verdicts with {username}. That belongs on the station wall.
A {streakCount}-match run with {username}. The kind of thing they put in the newsletter.
{streakCount} with {username}. Not one miss between you.
details: Hard to believe. Easy to admire.
I'm lost for words. Rare, for me.
A duo for the history books.

messages: Ten matches against {username}. A proper stand-off.
{username} has opposed you ten times running. You two should be in a film.
Ten in a row opposite {username}. Neither will back down.
A ten-match run against {username}. Stubborn as a parking warden.
Ten times at odds with {username}. I'd bring popcorn.
{streakCount} against {username}. That's not a rivalry, that's a case file.
{streakCount} in a row opposite {username}. Neither of you will move along.
{streakCount} straight clashes with {username}. Time for mediation.
A {streakCount}-match feud with {username}. Someone get these two a coffee.
{streakCount} against {username}. Impressive stamina. Do sit down.
{matchTitle} wraps in {timeLeft} and your vote isn't filed. Plenty of time.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. Your name's missing from the report.
{matchTitle} ends in {timeLeft}. I'd like your statement on this one.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. The shift's nearly over. Get moving.
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. Don't make me come and fetch you.
Only {timeLeft} until {matchTitle} ends. You've gone suspiciously quiet.
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. Last call, officer.
{timeLeft} left. Badge up and vote.
Final notice on {matchTitle}. {timeLeft}. Make it count.
{matchCount} matches missing your vote are about to shut. The earliest has {timeLeft} left.
{matchCount} unvoted matches and the clock's ticking. The nearest ends in {timeLeft}.
No votes on {matchTitle}. Somebody has to walk in first.
{moment1} against {moment2} and no one's weighed in. I'll wait. Briefly.
A fresh match, nothing on the record. Be first through the door.
{matchTitle} is a blank page. File the first report.
Round {round} is open. {matchCount} new cases on the board.
{matchCount} matches opened in round {round}. New shift, fresh patrol.
Round {round} is live, with {matchCount} matches to size up.
A new round. {matchCount} matches. Pick your beat.
Round {round}: {matchCount} matches awaiting your verdict.
{momentTitle} won. A neat bit of work.
{momentTitle} is through. Nicely handled.
{momentTitle} took it. Straight to the top of the board.
{momentTitle} won, and not a hair out of place.
{momentTitle} advances. One more on the board.
{momentTitle} moves on. Good call, officer.
{momentTitle} lost. A rough night.
{momentTitle} is out. Not the result I was after.
{momentTitle} didn't make it. Chin up, officer.
{momentTitle} went out fighting. That counts for something.
{momentTitle} is out. Grab a coffee. Come back.
{momentTitle} lost this round. A bad night, not a bad career.
{momentTitle} was eliminated. More cases are waiting.
details: Take it on the chin. Move on.

messages: Welcome to the force. {liveCount} matches are open. Pick one.
New recruit. {liveCount} matches are live. Welcome aboard.
Fresh face. {liveCount} matches need a verdict.
{liveCount} cases open on the board. Choose your side.
Welcome. {liveCount} matches live. Watch your step.
Day two. You turned up for the second shift. Good.
Two days running. Dependable.
Back for a second day. Noted in the log.
{days} days away. I was about to file a missing-person report.
{days} days, and you walk back in. Late, but welcome.
{days} days. I'd started to worry. Don't do that again.
{days} days off. A lot has happened on the beat.
Back on shift. Good.
Welcome back. Clock in.
Back already. Keen.
Ah. There you are, officer.
{totalVotes} vote{votesPlural}. A very quiet beat tonight.
Not many officers out on this one. That should change.
Light turnout. The whole squad's on a break. Come anyway.
Barely anyone's been by. Someone should look in.
details: It needs more eyes on the street.
Every vote counts on a quiet beat.

messages: {matchTitle} is tied and you haven't voted. You're the casting call.
Dead level on {matchTitle}. One vote breaks the deadlock.
A tie. Someone has to make the arrest. Let it be you.
{moment1} and {moment2}, locked together. Choose.
Still tied and the shift is nearly over. One last vote.
Level, with time running out. Vote.
Tied, and almost out of time. Please don't leave it hanging.
Still thinking it over? Dispatch won't hold forever.
Quit second-guessing. Choose and stand by it.
They all deserve a proper look. Trust your instincts.
You've been loitering long enough. Step up.
details: No wrong suspect. Only slow ones.

messages: First vote filed. Welcome to the force.
You picked a side. A good first report.
details: The first of many, I'd say. +{xp} XP

messages: Five votes. You're learning the streets.
Five. No longer a rookie.
Ten votes. The station knows your name.
Ten. You've earned your own chair.
Twenty-five votes. Your voice carries down the corridor.
Twenty-five. The whole precinct is listening.
details: Heard at the back of the room. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifty votes. Properly on the case.
Fifty. You clearly care. It shows.
A hundred votes. Expect a plaque in the squad room.
One hundred. Impressive. I'll say it just once.
details: A hundred. Wear the badge proudly. +{xp} XP

messages: Three days in a row. A good habit starts.
Three shifts straight. Dependable.
details: Turning up is half the job. +{xp} XP

messages: A full week. That's stamina.
Seven days running. Tough.
details: A week without a missed shift. +{xp} XP
Seven straight days on patrol. +{xp} XP

messages: Two weeks. You never miss a shift.
Fourteen days. Remarkable.
Thirty days. Thank you. I mean that.
A month on the beat. That says plenty.
details: Thirty days of showing up. +{xp} XP
A whole month on shift. +{xp} XP

messages: Five underdogs. You back the ones nobody else will.
Five long-shot picks. I like the style.
Fifteen underdogs. You swim against the traffic on purpose.
Fifteen. You answer to nobody's orders but your own.
details: Fifteen votes against the flow. +{xp} XP

messages: Thirty underdogs. Nobody can predict you.
Thirty. Backing the underdog is your signature.
details: Thirty votes for the one behind. +{xp} XP

messages: First on the scene five times. Quick off the mark.
Five times you got there before the rest.
details: Five votes ahead of everyone. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifteen times you made the first move. Decisive.
Always first through the door.
details: Fifteen votes in before anyone else. +{xp} XP
Ahead of the whole squad. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten close matches. Steady hands under pressure.
Another tight one. Nerves of steel, officer.
details: Ten finishes by a whisker. +{xp} XP

messages: Twenty-five tight matches. Your vote keeps swinging the verdict.
You've broken more than one deadlock.
Five times you stuck with the underdog. Loyal. I approve.
You never abandon a side that's behind. Honourable.
details: Belief in a last-minute rally. +{xp} XP
Five reversals you stood behind. +{xp} XP

messages: The same moment three times. Somebody has a soft spot.
That one again? It must have a good view.
details: You know which one you like. +{xp} XP
A single pick, voted three times. +{xp} XP

messages: Five votes on one moment. That's real loyalty.
You won't let that one go. I understand.
details: Loyal through thick and thin. +{xp} XP
A favourite pick, voted five times. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten votes on the same moment. That's a fixation.
Ten times, the same pick. I won't comment. Much.
Two rounds. You're sticking with it.
Round two and still on patrol. Good.
Four rounds. Deep into the case.
Deep in the bracket. Things get serious now.
details: Far from where you started. +{xp} XP

messages: Six rounds. You walked the whole beat.
All the way. You never clocked off.
details: From the first vote to the last. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten matches. You've covered a lot of ground.
Ten different matches. A thorough patrol. Good.
Twenty-five matches. You've looked down every side street.
Twenty-five. Not an alley left unchecked.
Fifty matches. That's not a visit, that's a career.
Fifty. You know this bracket better than the city maps.
details: A true veteran of the beat. +{xp} XP
Fifty matches on your record. +{xp} XP

messages: Five in one sitting. A long shift.
Five back to back. Do stretch your legs.
Ten in one go. A gruelling stretch.
Ten in one sitting. Proper stamina.
Voting at this hour? Night shift, or can't sleep?
The small hours. Duty, or insomnia. I know both.
You spread the word. Thank you.
Five shares. More officers, more strength.
Fifteen shares. You're practically a dispatcher.
Fifteen. You keep calling people in. Smart.
You were here before the first siren. A founding member, always.
One of the first thousand. That can't come off the record.
details: Nobody takes that from you. +{xp} XP

messages: A new rank. Properly earned.
Promoted. Wear it with pride.
Achievement unlocked: {name}. Nicely done.
Another stripe for the sleeve: {name}.
{rank}. Fully deserved.
You've put in the shifts and it shows.
Ten underdogs. Reckless. Reminds me of a few suspects I've known.
Ten outsiders. Nothing rattles you.
details: Ten calls against the odds. +{xp} XP
Long shots are your beat. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten close ones. You share my nerve.
Ten tight finishes. I'll admit, I'm impressed.
details: A steady hand on a tense night. +{xp} XP

messages: Seven days in a row. Dead-on aim.
A full week without a miss. Sharp work.
details: Seven days of pinpoint work. +{xp} XP
Seven days at the top of your game. +{xp} XP

messages: You broke the tie. One vote, one verdict.
A deadlock, and you made the call. Nicely done.
details: The vote that sealed it. +{xp} XP

messages: Officer Caitlyn, reporting for duty. Badge polished.
Caitlyn's yours now. Try to keep pace on patrol.

upcoming: Not open yet. Wait for the all-clear.
Voting hasn't started. I'll radio when it does.
Not yet. Patience is half of police work.
prevote: Two edits, one verdict. Take a proper look at both.
Examine both before you decide. No hunches without evidence.
I'm not telling you which I'd pick. That's your call.
Take your time. A careful verdict beats a hasty one.
Pick the one you'd testify for.
prevote-empty: Nothing on the record yet. File the first vote.
Quiet so far. Someone has to start.
Not one vote. Be the first on the scene.
closing-24h: Less than a day left and no vote from you. Get moving.
The window's closing. Make your move.
closing-3h: Time's short. Vote before shift change.
voted-early: You voted early, before the crowd. First on the scene.
Almost nobody had voted and you'd made up your mind. Decisive.
voted-ahead: Your pick is ahead. Good. The tide can still turn.
In front for the moment. Streets change.
{pick} is edging out in front. Sound judgment.
A lead is a lead. Don't get cocky.
voted-close: A hair apart. One more vote tips it. Call a friend.
Side by side at the line. Your pick needs backup.
voted-tied: Dead level. Neither side has the upper hand.
Absolutely even. Frustrating and thrilling in equal parts.
voted-behind: You're losing at the moment. Doesn't make you wrong.
{pick} is trailing. Underdog. I've been there.
They're ahead. You're not wrong, just outvoted.
Down by {diff} points. Spread the word. Call in everyone you know.
Most went the other way. Doesn't prove a thing.
closed-won: {pick} went through. You read it right.
closed-lost: Your pick lost. A shame. It was a fair call.
It didn't make it. Happens. Move on.
closed-tied: A tie. Neither side gave any ground.
closed-unvoted: Voting closed and you missed this one. There'll be others.
The match is over. {winner} took it. Vote sooner next time.

first-vote: Your first vote. Welcome to the force. Everyone's first call is jittery.
That's the first one. They get easier. Promise.
You're on the team now. Welcome.
streak: {streak} days straight. I see you clocking on.
You keep reporting for duty. I appreciate that.
underdog: You took the side nobody else would. Noted.
The long odds. That takes real nerve.
early: Early. You reached the scene before the rest.
Hardly any votes yet. Yours counts for plenty.
close: That vote tipped the balance. It's delicate.
Hair's breadth between them. One more vote flips it.
A tight one. Your vote counts.
behind: {pick} is behind. Behind isn't beaten. Call for backup.
Not leading yet. Plenty of work left.
Behind, not finished. There's a difference.
ahead: {pick} is ahead. Don't ease off. Things can turn.
In front for now. Don't trust it.
default: Your vote is filed. Plenty more to see.

live-fresh: {unvoted} matches and no votes yet. Start with the one you know best.
All the suspects are lined up. Choose. I won't rush you.
{unvoted} left. No pressure. Perhaps a smidge.
live-some: {voted} filed, {unvoted} still to go. Keep walking the beat.
You've started. {unvoted} still on the list.
A decent start. The rest won't file themselves.
live-few: Only {unvoted} left. Wrap them up before shift ends.
So close. Stay sharp to the end.
live-one: A final match. Don't leave the report unfinished.
One match between you and a clean sheet.
live-closing: A few wrap up in {timeLeft}. {unvoted} are waiting on your vote.
The clock's ticking. {unvoted} left, {timeLeft} to go.
Shift change is coming. Do hurry.
live-done: You've voted on everything. Well done. Have a look at the bracket.
Nothing outstanding on your list. Return when the next round opens.
live-none: Nothing's live right now. It will be. Browse the bracket meanwhile.
Quiet on the beat. Check back soon.
No matches open. I'm pacing the station as much as you.
brackets-groups: Groups come first. The top two from each move on. The rest don't.
All begin in a group. Only some get out of the holding cell.
Keep an eye on the tables. They shift fast.
brackets-knockout-soon: Knockouts are coming. The top two from each group advance.
No knockout round yet. The groups must wrap up first.
Be patient. The knockout appears once the groups wrap up.
brackets-knockout-live: Knockouts are live. Lose once and you're out.
One loss and you're off the force. No appeals.
Every match counts for more now. Choose carefully.
brackets-bracket: Round by round. One loss and it's over.
Follow the bracket. It narrows each round.
Each line on this board is a match somebody called.
brackets-complete: The cup is complete. Thanks for walking the beat with me.
That's a wrap. A hard-fought run. I'll miss the patrols.
We have a champion. A fitting end to the shift.
brackets-empty: No bracket on the board. Nothing's been drawn up.
Blank board. The draw's still to come.
Nothing here yet. Check back later.

invite: {a} or {b}. One vote settles it. Pick.
{a} against {b}: two edits, one verdict. File yours.
{a} versus {b}. Join the squad and tell me what you think.
voted: I voted {pick} over {other}. Where do you stand?
My vote goes to {pick} over {other}. Prove me wrong.
I picked {pick} over {other}. Think I'm mistaken?
early: Among the first votes on {pick} versus {other}. We need more witnesses.
I called {pick} over {other} early on. Add yours.
{pick} against {other}, hardly any votes. Yours would matter.
tied: {pick} and {other} are level. One vote decides it.
{pick} and {other} are tied. Someone make the arrest.
{pick} and {other} can't be told apart. Your vote can.
nailbiter: {pick} and {other} are {voteDiff} votes apart. Every one counts now.
{voteDiff} votes separate {pick} from {other}. Get yours on file.
{pick} against {other}, {voteDiff} apart. Either way it goes.
losing-close: {pick} is {voteDiff} behind {other}. A handful of votes turns it.
{pick} is {voteDiff} behind {other} yet far from finished. Back it.
losing-bad: {other} has {pick} beaten by {voteDiff}. It needs reinforcements.
{pick} is {voteDiff} short of {other} and deserves a fairer hearing. Vote.
{pick} is losing to {other} by {voteDiff}. Let's flip it.
winning-close: {pick} has {pct}% against {other}, narrowly. Help it hold the line.
{pick} is ahead of {other}, {pct}%. Not safe yet. Vote.
dominating: {pick} leads {other} on {pct}%. Come and see the evidence.
{pick} is well clear of {other}, {pct}%. Add your vote.
